versions.changelog: Questions now presented one at a time with Telegram inline buttons (3 multiple choice + type your own). Unique callback IDs per question to prevent stale button conflicts.

Initial release of daily-questions skill.

- Automates daily questionnaires to learn about the user and refine agent behavior.
- Two sequential question rounds: one about the user (updates USER.md), one about agent conduct (updates SOUL.md).
- Designed for cron job scheduling with configurable time, channel, and questions per round.
- Emphasizes conversation quality: varied, casual, non-repetitive, and well-organized documentation updates.
